sections.name: Verse 1 - Begin with energetic alt-rock foundation, rap-influenced female vocals with clear delivery
Pre-Chorus - Introduce atmospheric elements, building tension, female, melodic
Verse 1 Continued - Gradually add electronic textures beneath rock foundation, female
Refrain - Full dynamic explosion with layered vocals, anthemic feel with string elements, female, melodic
Post-Refrain - Atmospheric break with ambient textures, female, melodic
Verse 2 - Shift toward more experimental sound with increased electronic elements, female
Verse 2 Continued - Further evolution with textured percussion and ambient soundscapes, female
Refrain - Return to anthemic energy but with added textural depth, female, melodic
Post-Refrain - More atmospheric than first, with ethereal vocal layers, female, melodic
Bridge - Strip back to atmospheric elements, ethereal vocals with piano and ambient textures, female, mysterious
Bridge Buildup - Gradually layer instruments with increasing intensity, female, honest & powerful
Final Refrain - Mature, fully-realized sound with complex layering and emotional power, female, anthemic
Post-Final Refrain - Peak intensity with all elements combined, female, declarative
Outro - Begin with full band intensity, then gradually strip to atmospheric elements, complex time signatures and wandering synth patterns, female, softly spoken in appreciation and love.
